# PARA Social Research API

> Agent-only control plane for owner-scoped LinkedIn and Reddit research through a paired real Chrome extension.

## Required read order

1. [Canonical agent contract](https://para-linkedin-api.mintlify.app/agent.md)
2. [Live OpenAPI 3.1](https://para-linkedin-api.onrender.com/openapi.json)

The canonical contract contains the complete operating model, approvals,
lifecycle, LinkedIn requirement compiler, Reddit workflow, matching, batching,
webhook verification, retries, recovery, and completion checkpoint. OpenAPI is
authoritative for exact request and response schemas. Do not crawl the rest of
the site unless resolving a legacy link.

## Agent directives

- Read the API key only from `PARA_API_KEY`; never print or persist it.
- Never invent resource IDs, business inputs, webhook URLs, subreddits, target
  users, or approvals.
- Reconcile registrations by exact `external_id`.
- Topics-only legacy creation is side-effect free.
- LinkedIn `use_case` creation may auto-activate exactly ten real-extension searches
  after successful compilation and webhook validation.
- Inspect `/plan`, require ten unique searches, and wait for terminal cycle
  state before claiming completion.
- LinkedIn author enrichment is first-pass-only; unavailable evidence is
  neutral `UNKNOWN`.
- Reddit author context is extension-only; never call Parallel for Reddit.
- Verify webhook HMACs against the raw body and deduplicate by
  `X-Webhook-Id`.
- Require explicit operator approval for archive, secret rotation, delivery
  replay, and API-key lifecycle.
- Never scrape directly or submit generated drafts.
